name: Beszel
line: Monitors server health and probes ICMP, TCP, HTTP, and DNS targets.

free.text: Free MIT-licensed Hub and Agent; run them yourself

uptime.math: Beszel has no hosted plan, and the cost of a new server isn't known. It adds $0 only when it runs on an existing server with spare capacity.
